title: iris persica subsp. sieheana
intro: Iris persica subsp. sieheana, commonly known as Siehe's iris, is a subspecies of the plant Iris persica. It is a species of flowering plant in the family Iridaceae, native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, where it has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Siehe's iris include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
